title: Chapter 2737 - 99: Taotie Law
content:
Chapter 2737: Chapter 99: Taotie Law

In a small corner beside the cave, Mo Hua found a vacant spot, drew a Blazing Fire Formation, lit a fire, and was grilling meat for the Big Tiger.

The flames licked the tender meat, sizzling with oil.

The Big Tiger, drooling, stared fixedly at the grilled meat, its big copper bell-like eyes filled with intense focus.

When the meat was seventy percent cooked, the Big Tiger let out a roar, reminding Mo Hua:

"It’s ready!"

Mo Hua then stopped the fire and "offered" the grilled meat to the Big Tiger.

In face of such deliciousness, the Big Tiger wasn’t afraid of the heat at all and devoured the whole piece of grilled meat in three swallows, its big eyes narrowing to slits, seemingly enjoying it greatly.

Having received Mo Hua’s "offerings", the Big Tiger’s resentment for Mo Hua’s year-long absence dissipated with the aroma of the grilled meat.

Only then did the Big Tiger officially "forgive" Mo Hua.

There’s nothing that can’t be forgiven, as long as Mo Hua grills meat for it.

Soft rice isn’t as delicious as the meat grilled by Mo Hua.

Even though the "meat" grilled by Mo Hua was, in essence, the soft rice begged by the Big Tiger.

Seeing the Big Tiger eating so sweetly, Mo Hua couldn’t help but feel a bit tempted, and he curiously cut a small piece of meat, put it in his mouth, and chewed slowly.

Of course, he wasn’t a monster beast and dared not eat it when it was seventy percent cooked.

He ate it when it was fully cooked, the meat wasn’t as tender, but at least it wasn’t bloody, the monster qi was roasted clean, the burnt aroma was more intense, and the taste was soft, fresh, and fragrant.

Mo Hua was somewhat shocked.

He had never tasted such good "monster meat" before.

This monster meat was so delicious, it could almost rival the meat of spirit beasts, yet it held a touch of wildness and toughness absent in spirit beasts, along with a faint trace of monster qi, adding a unique flavor.

"Indeed... only Third-grade Monster Beasts know how to eat..."

In the "blood and flesh warehouse" of the Third-grade Golden Core Tiger Demon, there was such good meat, but it’s unclear exactly what kind of meat it was.

Mo Hua couldn’t help but look back towards the deeper part of the cave.

In the deeper part of the cave resided the fierce Third-grade Dangling Eyes Fierce Tiger.

At this time, the cave appeared eerie and pitch-black, and nothing was visible.

It would not let others reside beside its couch, especially when it’s a Third-grade mother tiger.

Mo Hua knew well that this mother tiger spared him only because of the Big Tiger’s favor.

But it’s uncertain how long the Big Tiger’s favor would last.

Therefore, while grilling meat, Mo Hua kept a distance from the Third-grade mother tiger to avoid provoking the fierce tiger who might suddenly unleash its wild nature and decide to "eat" him.

Meanwhile, Mo Hua was filled with doubts.

This is the Second Grade Mountain Realm, and this Third-grade... though he didn’t know the exact realm, judging by the monster qi and the swallowing clouds and mist aura, this extraordinary Dangling Eyes mother tiger, why did it come to reside here?

It couldn’t possibly have come simply for the Big Tiger, right?

And what about the other mother tigers?

They couldn’t have come just to offer themselves, letting the Big Tiger "eat soft rice," right?

Mo Hua’s expression turned somewhat delicate, he couldn’t help but feel a sense of "admiration" for the Big Tiger, yet he was also puzzled:

Why could this Big Tiger eat soft rice?

Even being able to eat a Third-grade Golden Core Realm mother tiger’s soft rice?

It was indeed rather incredible...

Because its bloodline was special?

Mo Hua recalled, deep in the Big Black Mountain, in the Black Mountain Stronghold where the evil cultivators gathered, the Big Tiger seemed to be caught by the Fourth Householder due to its special bloodline, akin to exotic beasts, to be bled every day for drinking.

This clearly indicated, that the Big Tiger’s bloodline ought to be outstanding.

With an outstanding bloodline, could it therefore "eat soft rice"?

Mo Hua glanced at the Big Tiger again, thinking it might not be just that.

This Big Tiger had a robust physique, its pattern was distinctly black and white, the black was profound and mysterious, the white was pure and bright, very beautiful, its golden brown eyes were sharp and spirited, emanating a majestic charm.

This would definitely count as a "handsome tiger" among tigers.

The Young Master Tuoba from the Great Wilderness Sect was so fond of it, not to mention the mother tigers.

It was natural for it to be liked by the mother tigers.

Of course...

Mo Hua’s expression became solemn.

He guessed there might be another reason:

War.

This war between the Taoist Court and the Great Wilderness had far-reaching effects, not only taking away most of the elite barbarian soldiers from the Barbaric Wilderness tribes.

It also nearly "seized" three thousand Barbaric Wilderness, the strongest group of tiger demons from various Demon Mountains.

These tiger demons were naturally "male."

This led to an abundance of mother tigers during the war-torn Barbaric Wilderness.

Tigers like the Big Tiger, with excellent bloodline, majestic appearance, and talents, naturally became "hot commodities."

Considering this, Mo Hua’s expression turned peculiar.

He had never expected things would develop this way...

In the turmoil, riding the Big Tiger, he came to the Barbaric Wilderness, essentially bringing along a "big stallion."

Mo Hua couldn’t help but think, if he, as a Shaman, "conquered" the Barbaric Wilderness and took the Big Tiger across the Barbaric Wilderness, would all mother tigers be "subdued"?

Is this... a Beautiful Tiger Strategy?

Mo Hua’s mind was stirring.

The Big Tiger was eating meat, seemingly noticing Mo Hua’s somewhat "impolite" thoughts, it howled twice, annoyed.

Mo Hua laughed, stroking its neck, though the "bad ideas" in his mind kept surfacing.

If the Big Tiger really used its charm to conquer the mother tigers in the Barbaric Wilderness and sired a bunch of tiger cubs.

Then in due course, this Big Tiger he raised from a young age, would it not become the "ancestor" of Barbaric Tiger Demons?
